data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Naphtali means 'my struggle' or 'my wrestling'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'pethilah' which means 'wrestling' or 'striving'. Naphtali is the name of the sixth son of Jacob and the father of the tribe of Naphtali in the Hebrew Bible.

The name Naphtali carries a strong sense of struggle and perseverance, making it an appealing choice for parents who wish to instill these values in their child. In Christianity, Naphtali is often associated with the tribe of Naphtali and the Biblical figure of Jacob, who wrestled with God and emerged victorious. The name Naphtali is also believed to have religious significance, representing the spiritual struggle and journey towards enlightenment and salvation.
